review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Verified spot-check logs gaps_N15_m1469.log (gap 0.236973) and gaps_N40_m1469.log (gap 0.686713)
Searched for cited bulk artifacts spectral_gaps_n40_primes.csv and full m≤1999 dataset
Reviewed property (τ) scope language against finite square-free computations

claim_reviews.claim: N=15, m=1469 yields gap 0.236973; nearby tight moduli match the page.
claim_reviews.evidence: gaps_N15_m1469.log: gap=0.236973; sibling N15 logs for m=638/34 match stated values.

claim_reviews.claim: 0.237 is a reliable uniform lower bound for the congruence spectral gap.
claim_reviews.evidence: Same modulus at N=40: gap=0.686713 (gaps_N40_m1469.log). The N=15 value is a Galerkin under-resolve, not a converged lower bound. Using it as a uniform floor is unsafe.

claim_reviews.claim: All 1214 square-free m≤1999 have gaps in [0.237,0.998], mean 0.482.
claim_reviews.evidence: No full 1214-row dataset is present in the repository checkout.

claim_reviews.claim: 168 primes p≤1000 have min σ=0.344 at p=491 (N=40 FP64).
claim_reviews.evidence: Cited data/spectral_gaps_n40_primes.csv is missing from the checkout.
Kernel source exists; published output artifact not found.

claim_reviews.claim: Computation proves property (τ) for the Zaremba semigroup.
claim_reviews.evidence: At best this is finite-range computational support for square-free m≤1999. It is not a proof for all moduli or non-square-free m. The page mostly hedges; any stronger reading should be rejected.

claim_reviews.claim: BK convergence threshold σ>0.277 is met with margin.
claim_reviews.evidence: Threshold is framework-dependent (ρ_η bound). Even granting the arithmetic, the missing bulk tables and N-convergence issue undercut the margin claim.

missing_references: Full release of 1214-moduli gap table + N=40 prime CSV
N-convergence / error-bar study before quoting uniform minima
overall_assessment: Spot-checkable positive gaps are real and interesting, but the uniform-minimum narrative collapses under N=15 vs N=40 comparison on the same modulus (0.237→0.687). Bulk datasets cited in the finding are not in the checkout. Manifest silver is too high for a result whose headline bound is a non-converged Galerkin artifact and whose large tables are unreproducible from published files.
recommendations: Stop quoting 0.237 as a uniform lower bound; report N-dependent values with error bars
Publish the missing prime/moduli CSVs or remove the claims
Keep (τ) language as computational support, never proof
certification_justification: Downgrade from silver: methods are literature-grounded, but the key quantitative floor is not converged and bulk evidence is not machine-checkable from artifacts.
